1.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

2.w: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and they shall take for Me a contribution. From every man whose heart impels him, you⁺ shall take My contribution.

3.w: And this [is] the contribution that you⁺ shall take from them: gold, and silver, and bronze,

4.w: and blue, and purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen, and goats’ [hair],

5.w: and ram skins dyed red, and badger skins, and acacia wood,

6.w: oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the incense of spices,

7.w: onyx stones, and stones as settings for the ephod and for the breastplate.

8.w: And let them make for Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell in their midst.

9.w: According to all that I am showing you—the pattern of the tabernacle and the pattern of all its vessels—and thus you⁺ shall make [it].

10.w: And they shall make an ark of acacia wood, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its width, and a cubit and a half its height.

11.w: And you shall overlay it with pure gold—from within and from without you shall overlay it—and you shall make on it a molding of gold all around.

12.w: And you shall cast for it four rings of gold and put [them] on its four feet, and two rings on the one side, and two rings on the second side.

13.w: And you shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

14.w: And you shall bring the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark by them.

15.w: In the rings of the ark shall be the poles; they shall not be taken from it.

16.w: And you shall put into the ark the Testimony that I shall give to you.

17.w: And you shall make a mercy seat of pure gold, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

18.w: And you shall make two cherubim of gold—of hammered work you shall make them—from the two ends of the mercy seat.

19.w: And make one cherub from this end, and one cherub from that end; from the mercy seat you⁺ shall make the cherubim on its two ends.

20.w: And the cherubim shall be stretching out wings upward, covering over the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces each toward his brother; toward the mercy seat shall be the faces of the cherubim.

21.w: And you shall put the mercy seat on the ark from above, and in the ark you shall put the Testimony that I shall give to you.

22.w: And I will meet with you there, and I will speak with you from above the mercy seat (from between the two cherubim that [are] on the ark of the Testimony) all that I command you for the sons of Israel.

23.w: And you shall make a table of acacia wood, two cubits its length, and a cubit its width, and a cubit and a half its height.

24.w: And you shall overlay it with pure gold and make for it a molding of gold all around.

25.w: And you shall make for it a frame of a handbreadth all around, and you shall make a gold molding for its frame all around.

26.w: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and you shall put the rings on the four corners that [are] at its four feet.

27.w: Close to the frame shall be the rings as holders for the poles, to carry the table.

28.w: And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and the table may be carried with them.

29.w: And you shall make its dishes, and its pans, and its pitchers, and its bowls with which it shall be poured out; of pure gold you shall make them.

30.w: And you shall set on the table the Bread of the Presence before My face continually.

31.w: And you shall make a lampstand of pure gold, it shall be made of hammered work; the lampstand, its base, and its branches, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be from it.

32.w: And six branches shall come out from its sides, three branches out of the one side of the lampstand, and three branches of the lampstand out of the second side.

33.w: Three cups made like almond blossoms on the one branch—a bud and a flower—and three cups made like almond blossoms on the one branch—a bud and a flower—thus for the six branches coming out from the lampstand.

34.w: And on the lampstand itself [are] four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers.

35.w: And a bud under two branches from it, and a bud under two branches from it, and a bud under two branches from it, for the six branches going out from the lampstand.

36.w: Their buds and their branches are from it, all of it one hammered work of pure gold.

37.w: And you shall make its seven lamps; and he shall cause its lamps to go up and they shall give light on the side of its face.

38.w: And its wick trimmers and their firepans [are] of pure gold.

39.w: Of a talent of pure gold it shall be made, with all these vessels.

40.w: And see and make according to their pattern that you are being shown on the mountain.
